activities.name: Skyward Bond (Guild Challenge)
activities.schedule: Floors 1–5 open at launch, higher floors unlock over time. The Guild Giftbox for Guild Hero's Realm is based on the highest floor the guild cleared the previous week.
how: A multi-floor guild tower. Early floors are Twin Lions and Ghost Master, killed inside a time limit.

Higher floors bring different bosses and climb in difficulty. Hard and Abyss tiers came in 1.8; 2.1 raised Hard to Tier 10 (Tiers 1–5 on Aug 20, 6–10 on Aug 27), with bosses including Guo Xin and Moongazing Maiden and new leaderboards.
Time limit example: Sleeping Daoist (Hard/Abyss) has 450 s since Jul 9 (was 360 s).
tips: Push the highest floor you can each week: it sets next week's Guild Giftbox tier for everyone in the guild.
Only one guild team needs to clear a floor for everyone to claim the Guild First Clear reward. Rotate who runs it so more people get the Personal First Clear too.
rewards: Guild First Clear (all guild members once any team clears)
Personal First Clear (players who cleared)
Better Guild Giftboxes for Guild Hero's Realm

activities.name: Guild Hero's Realm
how: A weekly guild activity that gives Guild Activity Points. Skyward Bond progress improves its Guild Giftbox.
Since 2.2 (Sep 16), boss talent tracking records reward counts for both bosses after a clear.
Ravening Banes runs as a Guild Hero's Realm (official Jul 2 notes fix its guild challenge).
Unclaimed rewards can still be claimed later the same week; invites now say whether they're for Guild or Wandering Paths Hero's Realm (official Jan 12 notes).
tips: Run it after the guild's Skyward Bond push, since the Giftbox is based on last week's highest floor.
rewards: Guild Activity Points (Treasure Tokens for the guild shop)
Guild Giftbox (tier from Skyward Bond)

activities.name: Guild War
activities.schedule: Saturday and Sunday at 20:30 on your battlegroup's server clock: Canglang & Jiangzhu UTC+8, Yunya (EU) UTC+2, Yougu (US East) UTC-4, Linhe (US West) UTC-7. Officially does not shift for daylight saving, so your local start time can move by an hour. See Group Tools for your local time.
how: Structured 30 vs 30 guild PvP on weekends.
Schedule set by the April 30, 2026 Arena & Guild War update. The in-game schedule panel is the authority if it changes.
2.3 changed Guild War Techniques, the Halftime Show and Guild Party (wherewindsmeet.org).
tips: Use the Guild War countdown on the Group Tools page so members in other time zones show up on time.
Because it doesn't follow daylight saving, US East now starts at 19:30 EST and EU at 19:30 CET (an hour earlier on the local clock than in summer).

2.4 Guild War EX changes: Panacea Fan EX heals longer and more (120–139% total) but healing from 3 sources in 60 s is cut 60% (4+ sources: 80%), so spread healers across targets. Also changed: Heavenquaker Spear, Inkwell Fan, Stormbreaker Spear, Everspring Umbrella and Museflow Waist Drum EX.
rewards: Guild war currency (for guild shops)

activities.name: Transdust Ruins (extraction, trio)
activities.unlock: Character Lv 20 and the quest Sands of Perils. Opened Sep 23, 2026 06:00 (UTC+8).
activities.schedule: Solo and Trio are open all day (since 2.3). Each match runs on a timer.
how: Modes: Solo, Trio, AI Solo and AI Trio.
Four phases: prepare, search, contest the valuable areas, extract.
Build a loadout from the Warehouse or Shop, loot the Hexi desert, deal with other players, and reach an exit before the timer.
You only keep loot you extract with. Exception: items in the small Safety Case are safe even if you die.
Random sandstorms change routes mid-run. Some exits have weight limits or tolls, slot counts vary by difficulty, and reaching an exit doesn't guarantee extraction.
tips: Bring gear you can afford to lose until the trio knows the map.
Put your hardest-to-replace find in the Safety Case early.
Avoid pointless fights: getting out matters more than kills.
Useful tools: Dragonfinder (finds high-value treasure), Breath-Holding Talisman (shrinks how far others detect you), Wind Sense (shows nearby enemy direction).
rewards: Golden Treasure Tokens (sell loot) → gear, supplies, cosmetics
Floral Weave → Lingering / Resonating Melody, accessories
Season Relics → decorations and poses
Limited: Deathknell Knight mask, Wind-kov avatar
verifyNotes: Whether the Tarkov crossover rewards are limited-time is unclear.

activities.name: Co-op Campaign Challenges
activities.unlock: Story campaigns (e.g. Qinchuan: Sunken City Lake, Fish Among the Algae, Azure Glow).
activities.schedule: Re-challenges are tracked weekly for accessory unlocks.
how: Campaign boss re-runs. Guild notes: they give martial art materials and targeted set gear (two set pieces per run).
The Qinchuan campaign re-challenges unlock accessories once each, with a Season Shop fallback.
tips: Campaigns can also be done in Solo Mode, which some season challenges ask for.
rewards: Martial art materials (guild notes)
Targeted set gear, two set pieces per run (guild notes)
Tranquility Pendant, Frosty Scales, Wayward Bloom (Qinchuan)
verifyNotes: The set-gear and materials rewards are from the guild research notes (research-notes.md); original source link was lost; no source re-read confirms them.

activities.name: World bosses worth grouping for
activities.schedule: Weekly first-clear rewards on some bosses.
how: Snowplum Requiem: the first defeat each week gives the big payout (Plum Parting, Memoir Gear, Inner Way Custom Chests, Echo Jade). Repeat clears feed Sword Forge challenges.
Wandering Ark (Hexi, in the Jade Gate Pass sandstorm, NE of the pass): a mechanics fight. Break its weak points; use Moonfall in phase two.
Version 2.3 added Tidewatcher, Old Raftsman and Shuttlecock Champion in Qingzhou (SenseOS).
Version 1.7 added Gilded Lament and Cat Emperor (SenseOS, GameSpace); Game8 also lists Jingniang the Blackclad and The Lone Tyrant.
Version 2.4 adds Wayfarer Bingshen (Moonveil Knoll) and Khitan shaman Yelu Abuli, added in 2.4 (Nov 13). See their own card.
tips: World-boss versions don't play like the Sword Trial / Hero's Realm versions with the same name. Don't use a world-boss guide in a raid.
Since Oct 15, the Multiplayer Wooden Stake lets a team practise rotations together with a live damage panel.
rewards: See each boss in game

activities.name: Hutuo world bosses: Wayfarer Bingshen & Yelu Abuli
activities.unlock: Unlock the Hutuo region (Lv 32, Kaifeng main chapter 'New Arrival in Kaifeng', then the quest 'Hutuo Memories').
activities.schedule: Live since the Nov 13 update (official 2.4 overview).
how: Wayfarer Bingshen: a former Dragonbend Academy student keeping vigil at Moonveil Knoll, in the north of Hutuo. A timing fight: parry and deflect red cues, dodge yellow ones.
Yelu Abuli: a Khitan princess and shaman priestess with an altar on the Hutuo River. Uses shamanic rituals and shapeshifts into an eagle, a wolf and ethereal foxfire.
rewards: Yelu Abuli first kill: Fire Offering, Shaman Bell, Medicinal Tales x3, Inner Way Note: Custom Chest x5, Echo Jade x20

Wayfarer Bingshen first kill: Lost Wayfarer, Medicinal Tales x3, Inner Way Note: Custom Chest x5, Echo Jade x20. Sword Forge Challenges (Trial menu) add the avatar 'Wayfarer Bingshen' and badge 'Trial: Inches Apart'

activities.name: Campaign: Hutuo River
activities.unlock: Unlock the Hutuo region in Hidden Mountain (Lv 32 + Kaifeng main chapter 'New Arrival in Kaifeng', then the quest 'Hutuo Memories').
how: A wartime campaign built around the Battle of Zhongdu Bridge, ending in a fight with the Khitan general Xiao Han (heavy attacks, Blood-forged Super Armor).
Three new Jianghu Legacies arrive with it: The Deepest Cut, Melody Amid Reeds and Kindle the Void.
Kindle the Void needs Hidden Mountain exploration progress of 6,000.
rewards: First clear: Winter's Defiance
Later clears: chance at Direwolf Spine (also in the Season Shop)

activities.name: Arena (1v1, 3v3, Group Strategy)
activities.schedule: 1v1: 24/7. 3v3: Mon, Wed, Fri, Sun 15:00–02:00 (next day) battlegroup time. Group Strategy: daily 12:00–02:00 battlegroup time. Season 5 first half ends Nov 26, 2026 04:59.
how: S5 modes: 1v1, Group Strategy, 2v2, 3v3 and Perception Forest (ratings reset from S4's second half).
Split into battlegroups by server region: Canglang, Jiangzhu, Yunya, Yougu, Linhe. You're placed by login server.
Switching battlegroup: first switch per half-season is free, the second costs 100 Echo Jade, then more. Switching resets Rank Points (you keep claimed rewards).
Matchmaking pauses from 2 hours before to 1 hour after each half-season or season switch.
tips: Group Strategy weeklies reset with the Monday reset.

2.4 (Nov 13): lower deflection caps on many skills (e.g. Third Theorem 4 → 3, Fleeting Trace 9 → 5, Greed Bane 6 → 3), better first-light-attack tracking, backward dodge rebalanced, and the Training Terrace now lets you practise 3v3, Perception Forest and Group Strategy. Re-check your Arena rotations.
rewards: Legend in any two modes other than Perception Forest: Night's Reckoning face accessory
Legend in any four modes: Invincible Charge pose
In modes that reset mid-season, a Legend finish in either half counts
Arena Talent EXP, Arena Attunement Stone, Jade Fish, Adventure Slips

activities.name: Taiping Mausoleum (Path Trial)
activities.unlock: S5 Phase 1 needs Foundation Trial Chapter 10 cleared. (Wandering Paths opens at Lv 22.)
activities.schedule: Season 5 Phase 1 ends Nov 26, 2026 04:59 server time.
how: Ten chapters of combat trials. Each has three star objectives (time left or HP left) plus a Divine Challenge.
Each chapter has a Mastery Boost and a Mausoleum Boost that favour certain builds.
S5: up to 60 stars of rewards; Mausoleum buffs for every path unlock in three groups: Basic, Mastery and Star.
Insight Jade cap reset to 600 for S5 (official 2.3 overview).
tips: Read each chapter's boosts and pick a build that matches.
rewards: Echo Jade and Coin per chapter
